notes: Large-unit check retained: אֲשֶׁר + בָ + הּ → 'whereof' is indivisible under rules 22 and 30; the suffix is 3fs and resumes the feminine antecedent אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם, so the one English word carries relation and resumption alike.

עַל־פִּי is split rather than fused because the ASV writes 'the commandment' for פִּי in particular, defeating rule 30's one-rendering condition; בְּיַד, for which it writes nothing beyond 'by', fuses.
